odaSpecification.document: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1
odaSpecification.interpretation: Flag bit 1 (mask 0x01) marks kGeneral and suppresses the type-specific variant. Flag bit 2 alone (mask 0x02) does not suppress it. Data type 2 is BD.
